item.title: 🟠 Hackers exploit critical Adobe Commerce flaw to hijack customer accounts
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
Attempts to exploit a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) in Adobe's Commerce and Magento e-commerce platforms have been detected, potentially allowing attackers to hijack customer accounts. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 9h ago
